correctness.rationale: The fixed-n,k uniform ordered-composition law has D=binom(n-1,k-1) outcomes. Marked zero shifts and adjacent equality give ordinary generating functions for E[U], E[A], E[UA]; the formal differentiation identity T(z)=2z²(k-3-z)(1-z)^(-(k-3))(1-z²)^(-2) proves the stated covariance formula. For k>=5 the nondecreasing h_j coefficients force positive sign at n>=k+2; parity analysis treats k=3 and k=4, and k=1,2 were separately counted. An independently written exact enumeration recomputed the rational covariance for every n<=15 and k<=n, matching the coefficient formula. This finite check corroborates, but does not replace, the formal proof.
